tests.description: A property value is a type test: the field's type picks the arm, and nothing binds a variable named after the type.
A named type in property position runs its validators, so a value of the right shape can still fail to match.
`key as name` binds the field to a different name.
A type test inside a nested object pattern.
A literal, a type test and a rename in one pattern: the type test still decides the match and the rename still binds.
